subject: Renewal procurement playbook — PO fanout and onboarding gaps
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Walker <megan.walker@meridianhealth.com>, Meridian Procurement <procurement@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 06 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal procurement playbook — PO fanout and onboarding gaps

Hi Megan / Meridian procurement team,

Thanks again for partnering with us on the upcoming renewal for Meridian Health (RDW-2027-0534). We expect a ~35% capacity increase for Q4 usage (term change + seats) and want to coordinate the procurement path so legal, finance, and your onboarding team have a clean handoff.

Proposed immediate asks / context:
- Were preparing a PO fanout to split spend across three quarterly POs to help Meridian budget smoothing (Q3/Q4/Q1). Need to confirm whether your portal requires a single consolidated PO or accepts staged POs.
- We will refresh vendor onboarding: updated W9, insurance cert, SOC2 snapshot, and a condensed evidence bundle. Sending an evidence zip in the next message.
- Clarify whether a term amendment (12 -> 18 months) needs a separate signature flow in DocuSign or can be appended to the PO.

Attachments: PO_template_v3.xlsx (draft), procurement_kickoff_agenda.pdf (proposed timeline) — Ive included a checklist below.

Checklist (what we plan to send):
1) Vendor evidence bundle (W9, SOC2 cover, ins cert, security questionnaire answers)
2) PO template (fanout version)
3) Term amendment draft (if required by legal)

Next steps: can you confirm: 1) the portal record owner for new vendor evidence; 2) if staged POs are acceptable; 3) any additional evidence fields we should prioritize (tax id, banking info, contact for onboarding)?

If helpful, we can set a 30-min kickoff with procurement + onboarding + our sales ops. Proposed times: Tue 6/8 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 6/9 14:00–14:30 PT.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Lead, Enterprise Renewals
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: Megan Walker <megan.walker@meridianhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Meridian Procurement <procurement@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 06 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal procurement playbook — PO fanout and onboarding gaps

Hi Kimberly,

Appreciate the clear plan. A few quick items from procurement: 

1) Staged POs: Our SAP instance prefers a single PO per fiscal commitment. Splitting into multiple POs is allowed but triggers an internal approval if the total commitment exceeds $250k. If you expect the total to exceed that threshold, please flag it now so we can route approvals early.
2) Evidence & portal: Well need the W9, insurance COI, and a completed vendor profile form in our procurement portal. SOC2 attestation is fine as a PDF.
3) DocuSign: Term amendments must be signed separately if they change payment terms. Standard SOW or term extensions can sometimes be attached to the PO in our system, but legal prefers a separate signature on material changes.

I can create the vendor record in the portal once you share the vendor contact and remittance address. Also sharing a link to our vendor intake form here: https://meridianhealth.procure/vendor-intake (internal).

If youd like, we can take the kickoff on Tue 6/8 10:00 PT — Ill block my calendar and include our onboarding lead.

Thanks,
Megan Walker
Sr. Procurement Manager
Meridian Health
megan.walker@meridianhealth.com
